items.quote: exposes a read-only `ValidationIssues` list on loaded messages and MSG documents to report structural anomalies encountered during strict parsing
items.truth: ValidationIssues exists on MsgReader and MapiMessage (not MsgDocument), and issues are only collected in non-strict mode; with strict=true the reader throws MsgException instead of recording an issue.

items.quote: the methods AddAttachment, AddEmbeddedMessageAttachment, AddRecipient, AttachMethodByValue, AttachMethodEmbedded, and AttachMethodStorage
items.truth: AttachMethodByValue, AttachMethodEmbedded and AttachMethodStorage are public const int fields (values 1, 5, 6), not methods.

items.quote: Aspose.Email.Foss.Cfb.DirectoryEntry is a public symbol that exposes the properties IsRoot, IsStorage, and IsStream.
items.truth: On DirectoryEntry, IsStorage(), IsStream() and IsRoot() are methods; the record's actual properties are StreamId, Name, ObjectType, ChildId, StreamSize, etc. (the README's own later table correctly calls them methods).

items.quote: the methods AddStorage, AddStream, and Children.
items.truth: CfbStorage.Children is a get-only IList<CfbNode> property, not a method.

items.quote: exposes the constructors CfbDocument, FromFile, FromReader, FromStream
items.truth: FromFile, FromReader and FromStream are static factory methods; CfbDocument's only constructors are CfbDocument() and CfbDocument(CfbStorage root, ...). CfbReader's row repeats the same mislabeling of FromFile/FromStream.

items.quote: `CfbReader` enables direct inspection and manipulation of the underlying structured storage format
items.truth: CfbReader is read-only (getters, Iter*/Find/Get methods); building or modifying CFB containers happens through CfbDocument/CfbStorage/CfbStream and CfbWriter.
